scenarios.name: life-op-losing-2-life-draws-2
scenarios.why: Vilis triggers on its controller losing life ("Whenever you lose life, draw that many cards"). The harness "life" op emits a real logged LifeChange, so a -2 to p0 queues the trigger; it must then be resolved before the draw is visible, and TriggerCount$LifeAmount binds X=2, drawing two.
